answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital locked in the network. Every node must maintain a persistent pulse of economic commitment to validate new blocks. Any thread of malicious activity results in slashing, an act that acts like the deep roots of a cedar tree, firmly anchoring the identity to financial risk. An attacker faces prohibitive costs because creating thousands of identities requires buying sufficient collateral to gain voting control.
